text.simple_config_lib.title: Simple Config Lib
text.simple_config_lib.option.tooltipMax: Maximum width of setting descriptions, in GUI pixels. Limited by the window width.
text.simple_config_lib.option.accentColo: Color of drag handles, the insertion line and the dragged element highlight.
text.simple_config_lib.option.editorMaxW: Maximum width of setting rows, in GUI pixels. Limited by the window width.
text.simple_config_lib.option.alwaysShow: Keep the search field visible. Escape clears the search before closing the editor.
text.simple_config_lib.option.slidersAsN: Use number fields for sliders when opening an editor. The context menu can still switch either way.
text.simple_config_lib.hub.title: Config Hub
text.simple_config_lib.confirm.title: Discard changes?
text.simple_config_lib.confirm.message: You have unsaved changes. Exit without saving?
